limitations: No human listening or physical iPhone Safari. PCM24 RAW preserves relative preset levels; MATCHED uses a fixed gain to .035 RMS capped at .8 peak, for comparison only. Quietness is a 20ms RMS threshold .0001; energy-rise count is a 20ms energy heuristic, not a musical onset classifier. Offline CPU includes graph/observation and is not a mobile deadline guarantee. All sources use the same deterministic seeds as JSON patches. Three long renders are 180s each.
